# Asteroids directional VFX improvements — Intake Brief

## Problem Statement

In the Asteroids control scheme the thruster flames are not key-specific. The main rear thruster should fire only while the forward key (**W / Up arrow**) is held, the right-side thruster only while rotate-left (**A / Left arrow**) is held, and the left-side thruster only while rotate-right (**D / Right arrow**) is held. Turn-only input shows only the relevant side flame (no main flame); combined forward+turn shows main plus the side flame; releasing all keys decays flames. The GDD currently documents rotate-right as S/Right and will be fixed to **D/Right** in this change.

## Users

- Player experimenting with the Asteroids control scheme in any gym scene, relying on the flame positions as the only heading cue (GDD §2.2, §7.2 — hull is direction-neutral).

## User Stories

- As a player using the Asteroids scheme, when I hold **W/Up** I see only the main rear thruster flame, so the VFX matches the forward thrust.
- As a player using the Asteroids scheme, when I hold **A/Left** to turn left I see only the right-side thruster flame, so the rotation is visually legible.
- As a player using the Asteroids scheme, when I hold **D/Right** to turn right I see only the left-side thruster flame.
- As a player holding both **W** and a turn key together, I see the main flame plus the corresponding side flame (thrusting while turning).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — Key-specific engine firing:** In the Asteroids scheme: `forward` (W/Up) fires only `main`; `turnLeft` (A/Left) fires only `rightSide`; `turnRight` (D/Right) fires only `leftSide`; no input fires nothing.
- **AC2 — Combined input:** Holding forward plus a turn key (W+A or W+D, including arrow variants) fires the main engine plus the corresponding side engine simultaneously; each flame animates with its scheme-scaled max (main 100%, side thrusters 70% via existing `port.size`).
- **AC3 — Turn-only and coast behaviour:** Turn-only input shows only the side flame (no main); the ship still rotates while turning (physics unchanged); releasing all keys decays all flames to zero (existing decay preserved).
- **AC4 — Directional controls:** The Asteroids scheme's rotate-right input is bound to **D** (and Right arrow), not **S**. The S key no longer turns the ship in the Asteroids scheme. Docs (GDD §2.1, README) updated accordingly; the 4-directional scheme's binding of S→down is unchanged.
- **AC5 — Input interpretation (D/S disambiguation):** With `controlScheme=asteroids`, pressing **D** alone turns right (side flame appears); pressing **S** alone produces no flame and does not turn the ship.
- **AC6 — 4-directional scheme unchanged:** The 4-directional scheme's four-cardinal engine firing, fractional `componentThrust` scaling and flame animation remain unchanged.
- **AC7 — Validation:** Unit tests cover per-key engine selection (forward-only, left-only, right-only, forward+left, forward+right), `getEngineSoundLevel` consistency, and D vs S disambiguation; existing relevant Player/movement/flame tests updated to assert main-only on forward (not all three); full project test suite passes with no regressions.
- **AC8 — Documentation:** GDD §2.1 control-scheme table and README scheme description are updated (S→D) and any GDD/UI-engine guidance (GDD §7.2) remains consistent; code comments referencing the control binding are updated.

## Constraints

- VFX-only change for AC1–AC3: no physics change — `AsteroidsModel.tick` rotation and thrust remain as-is.
- 3-engine layout is the scope (main rear + two 70% forward-side thrusters, AH-0MTF0EFNZ000RPVD AC2). Port geometry and sizes are unchanged (70% for side engines via `port.size`).
- Backward compatible with the 4-directional scheme (no regression, `componentThrust` untouched).
- SFX integration (AH-0MTFOSOHN001Q620) stays a placeholder (`getEngineSoundLevel`) — kept consistent but no audio playback is added here.
- Flame animation model (`src/utils/flame.ts` — growth ∝ `thrustAcceleration`, decay 4× growth, dt-based) is unchanged; only `AsteroidsModel.getEngineActivity` / `getEngineSoundLevel` and the input mapping change.

## Existing State

- `src/utils/movementModel.ts`: `AsteroidsModel.getEngineActivity` returns all three engines (`main`, `leftSide`, `rightSide`) whenever `forward` is true and none for turn-only input; `getEngineSoundLevel` returns 1 whenever any Asteroids key is held. `AsteroidsInputHandler.mapInput` binds turnRight to S/Right (WASD `S`, cursor Right).
- `src/entities/Player.ts`: 3-port layout (`ASTEROIDS_ENGINES`), per-port animated length via `preUpdate`→`updateFlameLength`, rendering in `_drawFlame`/`_drawPortFlame` (70% scale for side ports); `src/entities/Player.test.ts` currently asserts all three engines fire on forward-only thrust.
- Docs: GDD §2.1 and README describe `W/Up = forward, A/Left = turn left, S/Right = turn right`.
- Current bug: forward fires all three flames indiscriminately; turning shows no flame at all — the desired state is key-specific.

## Desired Change

- `src/utils/movementModel.ts`: change `AsteroidsModel.getEngineActivity(input, …)` to key-specific selection: `forward → main (scale 1)`, `turnLeft → rightSide (scale 1)`, `turnRight → leftSide (scale 1)`; combinations union the entries; update `getEngineSoundLevel` to return 1 whenever any firing engine would fire (kept in sync). Change `AsteroidsInputHandler.mapInput` to map `turnRight` to **D** (`wasd.D`) + Right cursor (remove the S mapping) — A/S remain the 4-directional bindings only.
- `src/entities/Player.test.ts` + `src/utils/movementModel.test.ts` (if present): update per-engine unit tests to assert the new mapping, including combined input and D vs S disambiguation.
- Docs: update GDD §2.1 and README from "S/Right = turn right" to "D/Right = turn right"; update inline comments in `movementModel.ts` and `Player.ts` that reference the binding.
- Preserve decay/restart behaviour in `Player.preUpdate`; verify side flames appear on turn keys alone (no other changes expected).

## Key Files

- `src/utils/movementModel.ts` — AsteroidsModel engine selection + AsteroidsInputHandler key mapping — Needs per-key engine selection and D-for-turn-right mapping
- `src/entities/Player.ts` — Asteroids thruster layout & per-port flame rendering (ASTEROIDS_ENGINES) — Verify turn-only flames render correctly; no geometry change
- `src/utils/flame.ts` — Flame animation model — No change expected (reuse as-is)
- `src/entities/Player.test.ts` — Per-engine flame tests for the Asteroids scheme — Needs updating (currently asserts all three on forward-only; add turn-only & combined cases)
- `src/utils/movementModel.test.ts` — getEngineActivity unit tests — Needs updating/adding per-key tests
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — §2.1 control-scheme table — Needs correction S → D for Asteroids turn-right
- `README.md` — Gym coverage control description — Needs correction S → D for Asteroids turn-right

## Related Work

- **AH-0MTF0EFNZ000RPVD** — Alternative player control (parent feature; established Asteroids scheme, 3-engine layout, pluggable handlers)
- **AH-0MTFRQR41000V57V** — Scheme-aware input routing in gym scenes (retired `keysToInput`; `player.getScheme()`-keyed handlers)
- **AH-0MTFRQR42001M8WQ** — Scheme-aware input tests for affected gym scenes (follow-up tests pattern to mirror)
- **AH-0MTFOSOHN001Q620** — Player thruster SFX (open; `getEngineSoundLevel` is its interface)
- **AH-0MTBOE8JM0040Z3Y** — Pure helper MovementInput → {firingEngines, flameScales} (4-dir pattern)
- **AH-0MTBOLP3Z005VRR9** — Per-engine flame rendering with component scaling

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Docs drift:** failure to update GDD §2.1/README alongside the code would leave S/D disagreement. Mitigation: include docs in the same PR; searched for all "turn right" references before submit.
- **D overlap with 4-dir:** D remains right-thrust in 4-dir; this work confirms `AsteroidsInputHandler` uses `wasd.D` while `FourDirectionalInputHandler` continues to treat D as right thrust — no conflict.
- **Scope-creep risk:** a 4th engine, SFX implementation, or thruster-geometry redesign are out of scope and should be tracked separately — note discovered opportunities as `discovered-from:AH-0MTFORPJ2003RWWQ` work items.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions

- **Q1 — Rotate-right key mapping (S vs D):** The description says rotate right = "d or right arrow", but GDD §2.1/README/`AsteroidsInputHandler` map turn-right to S/Right. **Which should rotate right** — D, S, or both? Affects input mapping, docs, tests. **Answer (producer, 2026-08-31): "d - fix in the GDD".** → Resolve to **D/Right = turn right**, **S deprecated for Asteroids**.
- **Q2 — Engine layout & exclusivity:** The description says "all 4 thrusters" but the Asteroids ship has 3 engines (main rear + two 70% forward-side). Confirm layout stays 3 engines with key-specific firing (main on forward, rightSide on turnLeft, leftSide on turnRight), side thrusters silent during forward-only thrust, no 4th engine. Also confirm the observed behaviour came from a stale build (dev code only fires on forward). **Answer (producer, 2026-08-31): "confirmed - observed in dev build".** → 3-engine, key-specific; no 4th engine; stale dev build.
- **Q3 — Combined-input/turn-only flames:** When forward + turn held, should both main + relevant side thruster fire? Side flames at existing 70% / full length, or shorter burst? **Answer (producer, 2026-08-31): "side flames show as long as the relevant spin key is pressed. If only a spin key then only that flame."** → Turn-only = side flame only; forward+turn = main + side; each flame shows while its key is held (existing animation cadence).

---

*Intake completed. Producer answers recorded above; ACs and Key Files finalised accordingly.*
